title: Weekend city
description: A city repo's city.json: every city fact the engine's scripts and website use.

siteName.description: The site's name, such as WeekendBoise. Also the User-Agent product token (keep it stable, since site owners' robots.txt rules match it), the robots.txt agent in lowercase, the data commit author, and the report sender's name.

domain.description: The site's domain, such as weekendboise.com. Reports are sent from reports@ this domain.

repo.description: The city repo on GitHub, owner/name. Used in the User-Agent contact URL, issue links, and report links.

cityName.description: The main city, as in "midnight Boise time".

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, such as America/Boise. Every event time is written in it.

state.description: The state events must be in. Adapters that filter by state keep only this one, and addresses are read with it.

cities.description: The cities an event can be in, in schema order. Other is added by the engine.

cityAliases.description: Place names that count as one of the cities, such as McCall for Valley County or Gunbarrel for Boulder.

ambiguousCities.description: Cities whose names are also everyday words or surnames. They count only from a ZIP code or a "City, ST" pattern.

zipRanges.description: ZIP ranges for one city, applied after zipCodes to any ZIP in the range that zipCodes does not list.

titleAbbreviations.description: Short forms expanded before titles are compared for duplicates, such as bsu to boise state university. Lowercase.

searchAliases.description: Search words that also match their long forms on the site, such as bsu to boise state. Lowercase.

cityListLast.description: Cities pinned after Other at the end of the site's City list.

coordinates.description: Where the site's sky theme follows sunrise and sunset.

logDatabase.description: The Cloudflare D1 database holding the visitor log, as in wrangler.jsonc.

about.description: City text on the About page. HTML is allowed.

intro.description: What the site lists and where.

cityNote.description: Extra sentence for the City column, such as how a county is grouped.
